title: Open Agent Rules operator configuration
description: How an operator runs someone else's rule pack without forking it: disable a rule, or roll one out in monitor mode. A configuration changes whether and how loudly a rule runs, never what it means ([OAR-CFG-1]-[OAR-CFG-7]).

disable.description: Rules to treat as though their enforcement were off. An engine rejects an entry naming a rule that is not loaded, or one whose mandatory is true ([OAR-CFG-2], [OAR-CFG-4], [OAR-CFG-5]).

enforcement.description: Replaces a rule's own declared enforcement ([OAR-CFG-3]).

ruleRef.description: A bare id or a qualified <namespace>/<id>.
